blocks.text: Surrey real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends
Surrey condos and townhomes by price band, October 2026

146 condos and townhomes sold in October against 1,434 listed. The price band with the most sales was $300,001 to $400,000, with 27 sold (18% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $900,001 to $1,000,000 at 16%.

With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Surrey Condos: streets and boundaries

items.t: Towers cluster in Whalley at City Parkway, 104 Avenue and King George Boulevard; low-rise stock lines King George Boulevard in South Surrey, Guildford and Newton.
City Centre is a planning core inside Whalley, not a board area — City Hall, Simon Fraser University (SFU) Surrey, Kwantlen Polytechnic University (KPU).
Guildford centres on Guildford Town Centre, the province's second largest shopping centre per the City.

blocks.text: Surrey Condos: the housing stock

items.t: PARKWAY Aspect, Whalley — Bosa Properties: four towers, over 2,000 homes, City Parkway and 104 Avenue; Aspect move-in ready, early 2027 (as of November 3, 2026).
King + Crescent, South Surrey — Zenterra Developments: completed; four six-storey buildings, one to three bedroom condos; wood-frame low-rise strata.
Strata tenure is standard — City bills multi-family (strata) units separately: 2026 water $454, sewer $571.

blocks.text: Surrey Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Strata units carry no suite rights.
Apartments on City services: recycling and organics $46.55 in 2026; recycling only $35.42; with taxes due July 2.

blocks.text: Surrey Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Metered strata buildings bill every four months; sewer is 88 percent of water supplied.
Metro Vancouver bulk costs are 75 to 86 percent of utility charges per the City — why strata sewer is $571 versus $1,661 per house, 2026.
Additional school tax applies to stratified condominium units assessed at $3 million and over — City tax page.
Holland Park, beside the Whalley towers, hosts the annual Fusion Festival.
R6 Scott Road is Surrey's newest RapidBus, on a region's-busiest corridor — City transit update, 2025.

blocks.text: Surrey Condos: getting around

items.t: City Centre: four SkyTrain stations per the City, including Surrey Central and King George.
R1 King George Boulevard RapidBus: Guildford Exchange to Newton Exchange; every 10 minutes peak, 15 off-peak, 6 a.m.–midnight.
Fleetwood and Clayton gain Fraser Highway stations, Green Timbers to Clayton, on the Surrey-Langley extension.

blocks.text: Surrey Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: Screen lowland low-rise buildings against City floodplain mapping; Crescent Beach has a floodplain map, permit guide and Flood Construction Level.
Read the strata's depreciation report, bylaws, minutes and Form B — no City page states building rules.
At PARKWAY, confirm parking and storage tenure — the sales page states no entitlements.

faq.q: Where do towers stand, versus low-rise?
faq.a: Towers stand in Whalley, around City Parkway, 104 Avenue and Surrey Central Station, where the City describes emerging residential high rises at a transit hub. Low-rise wood-frame is the form elsewhere — King + Crescent in South Surrey is four six-storey buildings. Guildford and Newton buyers should expect low-rise, older strata and confirm form by address.
That is the developer's wording. A unit's completion, disclosure and deposit terms still need reading in its own contract documents.

faq.q: What City bill sits beyond strata fees?
faq.a: A flat-rate strata unit pays $454 water and $571 sewer in 2026, $1,025 total, plus $46.55 recycling and organics on City collection. Those are City charges only. Strata fees, insurance and contingency contributions are set by the strata corporation and appear only in its documents.

faq.q: Can I rent it out, or keep a large dog?
faq.a: The strata decides, not the City. Obtain them for the exact building before an offer depending on renting or pets.
